message: pyarrow is not installed, so text columns are stored as Python strings. With pyarrow the .str methods ran 3 to 11 times faster on 1,000,000 rows. Add pyarrow to the project.
bottleneck is not installed. With it std ran 4 times faster and median 1.7 times faster on 10,000,000 rows. Add bottleneck to the project.
The project has a type checker but not pandas-stubs, so calls to pandas are not type checked. Add pandas-stubs as a development dependency.
